variants.advanced: Create interactive timeline component. Layout options: vertical (default), horizontal (scrollable). Vertical timeline: alternating sides (left/right) on desktop, single side on mobile. Line: pseudo-element connecting items, gradient or solid color, animated drawing on scroll. Marker: customizable icon or avatar, different colors by event type, pulse animation for current/active. Content card: hover elevation, expandable on click for more details. Date display: relative time (2 days ago) or absolute, grouped by year/month headers. Media support: images, videos in cards. Connected events: visual grouping of related items. Filtering: filter by type, date range, search. Load more: pagination or infinite scroll for long timelines. Animation: staggered reveal on scroll (Intersection Observer), slide in from side. Zoom levels: year/month/day granularity for dense timelines. Export: print-friendly version. Accessibility: semantic list markup, keyboard navigable, proper ARIA labels.
